description: This file defines the TokenRefresher class, which manages refresh-token logic in a coroutine-safe manner. It interfaces with token storage and a mock API service to refresh session tokens, designed to be used with OkHttp's Authenticator.

classes.name: TokenRefresher
classes.description: Class responsible for handling refresh-token flow in a thread-safe manner, bridging blocking API calls with coroutines.

methods.name: refreshBlocking
methods.description: Performs a token refresh operation in a blocking manner, ensuring only one refresh at a time via a mutex.
